reason: I'll start the iron-recovery goal: the picture shows recycling cells breaking down worn red cells containing iron.
expectation: I expect the recycling cells to recover iron for the marrow, though I'm not sure what form it will take.

alternatives.reason: Growing replacement skin cells also fits a goal, but I want to follow the iron route first.

effect: The iron is carried in blood by proteins, so I can follow it to the marrow.
reaction: It's interesting that the iron can be reused without the recycling cells being used up.
reason: I'll continue the iron-recovery goal by combining the recovered iron with marrow, where developing blood cells are shown.
expectation: I expect the marrow to use the iron to help make new red blood cells.

alternatives.reason: The skin cells also need materials to grow, but I want to finish following the iron first.

effect: The recovered iron became part of haemoglobin in new red cells, while stem cells remained in the marrow. The skin goal is next.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the recycled iron used in new cells.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the picture shows the materials reaching the dividing skin cells.
expectation: I expect the cells to use the supplied materials to grow replacement skin cells.

effect: The skin result completes the second goal and shows new cells replacing old ones while the covering stays intact.
reaction: The continuous layer and shedding flakes make the replacement process easy to picture.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into new red blood cells was most worthwhile because it connected recycling to the oxygen-carrying protein in the new cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing skin cells was the least engaging decision: it was the only offered combination, even though the result clearly showed renewal.

surprise.text: The recovered iron travels in blood on proteins and becomes part of haemoglobin in new cells, while the marrow remains.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave both pairings a clear purpose.

continue.text: I'd probably continue for another chapter to see another body process connected in this way, though the choices here were fairly straightforward.
